CVE-2026-123633 (HTTP/2) and CVE-2026-121810 (HTTP/3) are use-after-free bugs in connection draining with proxying to a backend. CVE-2026-123634 is a resolver use-after-free needing a request-derived proxy_pass target plus SSI or mirror subrequests. CVE-2026-113425 hits the mail proxy when proxy and auth_http are combined.

- Root chain: code execution lands as the NGINX worker, then a separate Linux kernel SCTP use-after-free or double free (code introduced in Linux 4.15) escalates to root. The researchers say the chain also crossed a Docker container boundary. That kernel bug has no CVE and no fix yet. ATT&CK per the report: T1190, T1068, T1611.

- Exploit reality: the public PoC for CVE-2026-123007 (GitHub, November 18) gets code execution against NGINX 1.31.8 with HTTP/2 over TLS in a Docker lab. It needs x86-64 with AVX-512 and a particular glibc memory-copy routine, has to defeat ASLR, and pushes roughly 128 GB of HTTP/2 traffic down a single connection. A proxy terminating HTTP/2 in front of NGINX will most likely stop it. The discoverers and another team hold working exploits but withheld the final steps. Fake exploit repos are circulating, so vet anything you pull.

The warning signs come from CIRCL's advisory; the grep is from the report's checks.

Run nginx -T 2>/dev/null | grep -nE 'http2|http3|quic|resolver|proxy_pass|mirror|ssi on|auth_http' to see which flaws apply. Check bundled NGINX in container images, appliances and load balancers. Community ingress-nginx is retired with no fix planned. After upgrading, do a full restart, because a reload keeps the old binary running.

If patching waits, disable the feature behind each flaw. Turning off HTTP/2 covers only CVE-2026-123007 and CVE-2026-123633, and disabling mirror alone leaves CVE-2026-123634 open. On hosts that do not need SCTP, add install sctp /bin/false under /etc/modprobe.d/ and confirm with lsmod, since an already-loaded module stays active until reboot or removal. Check sysctl kernel.randomize_va_space (2 is full) and look for services launched with setarch -R. Preserve error logs and worker core dumps before restarting.

Researchers observed that low-privilege database accounts — granted only temporary table rights — can trigger memory-corruption bugs in PostgreSQL, MySQL, and ClickHouse engine code to achieve full OS-level RCE. The Oracle chain (CVE-2026-114819, CVSS 9.9) requires no credentials at all. SQL permission boundaries do not constrain memory-unsafe execution paths — the blast radius begins at the database tier and extends outward from there. Runtime segmentation restricting east-west traffic from database hosts helps contain post-compromise lateral movement before it reaches adjacent services.

#CloudSecurity #ZeroTrust

🔗 Full TRC analysis: https://t.co/nTx00Kc0xI

A database user with almost no permissions can potentially turn a SQL connection into a shell on the server

Security researcher Zheng Yu demonstrated this against PostgreSQL, MySQL and ClickHouse, and found a separate attack chain against Oracle

The research exposes a gap between database permissions and the code those permissions allow users to reach

Even when an account cannot access application tables, it can still interact with components such as query optimizers, aggregate functions and binary data parsers

A memory corruption flaw in one of those components can turn limited SQL access into operating-system command execution

The demonstrations included:

PostgreSQL — CVE-2026-116331

A type-confusion bug in the query planner allows a default login role to construct objects in its temporary schema and eventually execute commands as the PostgreSQL service account

MySQL — CVE-2026-101786

An out-of-bounds write in windowed BIT_OR aggregation can be triggered using prepared statements and oversized binary input

vulnerabilities.description: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4 text.c that allows heap out-of-bounds reads by casting a Text node's fontStyle field to M FontStyle unchecked. Attackers can craft an XMT/BIFS scene placing a smaller node like Face in fontStyle, causing build text to read past the allocation and crash MP4Box.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in xmt remove od links recursive() in loader xmt.c that lacks any depth limit when walking node children. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with deeply nested or cyclic node and SFCommandBuffer references to exhaust the stack and crash MP4Box on import.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in gf sg proto instantiate() in src/scenegraph/vrml proto.c that lacks cycle detection or depth limits. Attackers can craft an XMT scene whose PROTO body instantiates itself directly or indirectly, exhausting the stack and crashing MP4Box when imported.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in gf sg command apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c that misinterprets single node values as child lists for MFNode field replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that causes an invalid node pointer to be dereferenced by gf node register(), crashing MP4Box for denial of service.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf sg command apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c when handling MFNode field replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with an MFNode field replace command lacking a node value to crash MP4Box, causing denial of service.

OpenShot Video Editor (openshot-qt) through 4.1.1 contains an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in ProjectDataStore.load() and read legacy project file() that passes non-JSON project files to pickle.load() without restriction. Attackers can trick users into opening a crafted .osp project file containing a pickle  reduce  gadget to execute code with the user's privileges.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in gf event target get node() because destroyed node event targets remain in media object lists. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nodes such as InputSensor to trigger freed memory reads during gf scene disconnect(), crashing the process or corrupting heap memory.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in JSScript LoadVRML() in src/scenegraph/vrml js.c that reads unchecked script text pointers of Script node url entries. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene loading a Script node whose url entry lacks script text, crashing MP4Box and causing denial of service.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability because xmt find node() in loader xmt.c resolves DEF names without verifying the node belongs to the current scene graph. Attackers can craft an XMT scene reusing a PROTO node across graphs, causing gf node unregister() to read freed memory during teardown, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the BT/XMT context loader that frees an interaction-type decoder-specific descriptor even when UIConfig re-encoding fails. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with a BIFSConfig descriptor, causing gf odf delete descriptor() to reuse and free it again, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that leaves freed node URL fields in the pending object descriptor link list after SFNode replacement. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that reassigns a single-node field, causing xmt resolve od links() to read freed memory, crashing the process and potentially corrupting the heap.

Gammapy through 2.1 contains a code injection vulnerability in WcsGeom.from header() that passes the WCSSHAPE FITS header card to eval(). Attackers can supply a crafted .fits file with a Python expression in WCSSHAPE, executing code as the user who loads it via Map.read().

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf sg proto create node() in src/scenegraph/vrml proto.c when cloning PROTO instances. Attackers can craft an XMT scene declaring more PROTO interface fields than the cloned instance supplies, crashing MP4Box when a user opens the file.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application by supplying a crafted XMT scene. Attackers can modify InputSensor, Layout or EnvironmentTest nodes during parsing, triggering compositor handlers that read uninitialized private stacks and cause denial of service.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in load xmt done() in src/scene manager/loader xmt.c that reads freed nodes during XMT parser teardown. Attackers can craft an XMT scene with a scene replace command that destroys PROTO sub-graphs, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting heap memory when opened.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that allows scene commands to reference PROTO sub-graph nodes freed by a scene replace command. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that causes gf node get field() and gf node unregister() to access freed memory, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting heap memory.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in avi parse input file() in src/media tools/avilib.c that increments track counters before checking AVI MAX TRACKS. Attackers can supply a crafted AVI file declaring a ninth audio stream, causing AVI audio format and AVI close() to access track[8] and crash the process.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in xmt node end() that leaves freed child node MFURL fields in the OD link list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with an extra top-level SceneReplace node, causing xmt resolve od links() to read freed memory, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf sg proto del that allows attackers to free PROTOs still owned by another scene command via the GF SG PROTO DELETE handler. Attackers can craft an XMT scene that declares a PROTO in one command and deletes it by ID in another, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory when opened.

libexpat through 2.10.0 contains an improper Unicode handling vulnerability in DEFINE UTF16 TO UTF16 conversion functions in xmltok.c that can split valid surrogate pairs when output space is limited. In XML UNICODE builds parsing non-native byte order UTF-16 input, attackers can supply crafted documents that deliver lone high surrogates to character data and default handlers.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in scene graph teardown that allows attackers to trigger access to freed memory via crafted scene files. A node shared across multiple PROTO node code lists is freed by gf sg reset(), and gf sg proto del() then calls gf node unregister() on the dangling pointer, crashing MP4Box.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in curve2d check changes() that casts a Curve2D point field node to M Coordinate2D without type checking. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BIFS scene placing another node type such as LinearGradient in that field, causing an invalid pointer read that crashes the process.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in ctxload process() in src/filters/load bt xmt.c that casts object descriptor update entries without checking the descriptor tag. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BT scene placing a different descriptor type in a GF ODUpdate command, causing gf list get() to dereference an invalid pointer and crash MP4Box.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf sg command apply() that allows attackers to crash the application via indexed field-replace commands lacking a payload. Attackers can craft an XMT scene whose GF SG XREPLACE command on an MFNode field carries no value, causing a crash and denial of service when opened.

Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene where xmt node end() frees a subtree containing InputSensor MFURL fields, causing xmt resolve od links() to read freed memory and crash MP4Box.

Freedit before 0.9.9 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the post lock, post hide, post pin and comment hide handlers that allows inn moderators to act on content from other inns. Attackers can supply their own inn id with a foreign post or comment id to lock or hide content instance-wide, or pin private posts to expose titles.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in xmt discard subtree() in src/scene manager/loader xmt.c that allows attackers to exhaust the call stack. Attackers can persuade a user to process a crafted XMT file with deeply nested discarded SFNode and MFNode fields to crash MP4Box.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap-based buffer over-read vulnerability in gf xml sax peek node() in src/utils/xml parser.c that lets attackers read past the heap line buffer. Attackers can craft an XMT file whose ROUTE or command references a later-defined node, crashing MP4Box when a user imports it.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt resolve od links() in loader xmt.c that allows attackers to read freed heap memory via stale strstr() pointers. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file whose MFURL field contains an entry without a URL string, causing sprintf() to read freed memory and crash the process.

OpenAirInterface CN5G PCF through 2.2.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in pcf smpc::delete sm policy handler() that leaves stale UE IPv4, SUPI and DNN index entries after association deletion. Attackers can trigger repeated SM policy create and delete cycles over N7 via PDU session establishment and release to grow PCF memory without bound and break association lookups.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory when xmt node end() discards an out-of-scope node without resetting command-buffer state. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that leaves parser->command buffer and parser->command dangling, causing later parsing to access freed memory and crash MP4Box.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt node end() in src/scene manager/loader xmt.c that writes to freed heap memory when replacing single-node field commands. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file where a Conditional node owning the command is unregistered, corrupting heap memory and crashing MP4Box.

Mailflare before 48957fb contains a host header injection vulnerability in the password-reset request handler that allows unauthenticated attackers to poison reset links when APP URL is unset. Attackers can submit a reset request for a victim's email with a malicious Host header, capturing the single-use token when the victim clicks the link to take over the account.

vulnerabilities.description: Open5GS AMF through 2.8.0 contains a missing resource release vulnerability that allows authenticated UEs to orphan SMF sessions by triggering Create SM Context response processing failures. Attackers can repeatedly release the RAN UE context while responses are pending, causing AMF SESS CLEAR() without Release SM Context requests and degrading SMF availability.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted XMT files. Attackers can persuade a user to process an XMT file whose discarded out-of-scope nodes cause gf node unregister() to dereference a freed child, crashing the process.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4 sensors.c that allows attackers to crash the process via uninitialized sensor nodes. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that makes compositor mpeg4 get sensor handler ex() call hs->IsEnabled through a near-NULL pointer, causing denial of service.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to access freed heap memory by supplying a crafted XMT file. When xmt parse element() replaces an SFNode field child, the freed node stays cached in parser->peeked nodes and a later DEF lookup passes it to gf node get name(), crashing MP4Box.

Servas before 1.2.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to modify and delete other users' data by supplying target resource ids. Attackers can abuse TagController update and destroy, LinkController destroy, and GroupController destroy actions to rename or delete tags and delete links and groups.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in TraverseForm() in src/compositor/mpeg4 form.c due to an off-by-one groupsIndex bounds check. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with a Form node having constraints but an empty groupsIndex field to crash MP4Box, causing denial of service.
